title: 음식 이름 읽기 2: 찌개, 국, 탕, 볶음
objective: Read food names ending in 찌개, 국, 탕 and 볶음 aloud, and tell what kind of dish it is.
summary: Learn four common endings of Korean food names.

task.title: Read the food names
task.line: Look at the end of each food name, then say what kind of dish it is or how it sounds.

words.exampleMeaning: People eat seaweed soup on their birthday.
People eat chicken and ginseng soup in summer.

letters.sound: [찌개] stew: thicker, with less broth than 국, strong salty taste
letters.as: jji-gae; jj is a tight 'j' with no puff of air

letters.sound: [국] light soup, eaten with rice; after a ㄱ final consonant it sounds [꾹]
letters.as: guk; final k is stopped, not released: 미역국 [미역꾹]

letters.sound: [탕] hearty soup, often boiled a long time
letters.as: tang; strong puff of air, like 't' in 'top'
bo-kkeum; final ㄲ moves to the next syllable 음

exercises: Write what each dish is (stew, soup, hearty soup, or stir-fried): ① 순두부찌개 ② 곰탕 ③ 멸치볶음
Write how each name sounds, in [ ]: ① 감자볶음 ② 떡국 ③ 김치볶음
Complete the food name with 찌개, 국, 탕 or 볶음: ① 부대____ (a stew) ② 해물____ (a hearty seafood soup) ③ 콩나물____ (a light soup eaten with rice)
Read the menu and answer: 제육볶음 · 해장국 · 참치찌개 · 설렁탕 ① Which dish is stir-fried? ② Which dish is a stew? ③ Which two dishes are soups?
answers: ① stew ② hearty soup ③ stir-fried
① 부대찌개 ② 해물탕 ③ 콩나물국
① 제육볶음 ② 참치찌개 ③ 해장국, 설렁탕 (any order)
